items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Harry James play in there... I recommended Harry James.

ctx.x: Yeah, '34, I think. Their big thing was that radio show.

Yeah, '34, because we was working in the Casino de Paris. There was Ben Pollack and Chick, and Ben Pollack was playing -- Harry James play in there. (Unintelligible) was the drummer. Miller was the tenor. And Benny was getting his band together.
And now, I recommend to Benny -- I play trumpet for a guy. He used to call it Luis Garcia. Luis Garcia was a very popular popular trumpet player. He was with Whiteman for a while.

items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: He couldn't -- no, he couldn't make it. He got (inaudible) took (inaudible) about 20 minutes. He say for me -- he couldn't find himself.

ctx.x: And then later on, way later on after he (inaudible) and that, he was playing -- he was (inaudible) with me for a while, playing as a side man.
And what about Harry Sweet Edison Jameson (phonetic), you had trouble --
He couldn't -- no, he couldn't make it. He got (inaudible) took (inaudible) about 20 minutes. He say for me -- he couldn't find himself.
